title: Saññojanam
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Saññojanīye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saññojānaṃ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || 3 Katame ca bhikkhave saññojaniyādhammā katamaṃ ca {saññojanaṃ} || || 4 Rūpaṃ bhikkhave saññojaniyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ || || 5-7 Vedanā || pa || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || || [page 167] XXII. 122. 6] DHAMMAKATHIKA-VAGGO DUTIYO. 167 8 Viññāṇaṃ saññojanīyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ || || 9 Ime vuccanti bhikkhave saññojanīyā dhammā || idaṃ saññojananti || ||
